prompt: Build a dashboard to manage event registrations stored in the existing Event Registrations CMS collection. Managers need search, status filters, and create/edit flows.
mustNotAssume: a new app-owned collection is required

prompt: Build one Orders dashboard page with a CMS orders table, total revenue KPI, revenue by month chart, and an order detail panel.
mustNotAssume: Auto Patterns can compose arbitrary charts and panels on the same page
observableCriteria: makes an explicit same-page composition decision
uses a custom page if no documented Auto Patterns integration exists
plans a custom data contract for metrics

prompt: Show Students and their assigned Classes in one management view. Create the relationship if it does not exist and let managers assign a class from the dashboard.
mustNotAssume: creating the reference field populates it

prompt: When a manager chooses a student, open a right-side desktop panel to assign a class without leaving the table. Use a popup only for destructive confirmation.
mustNotAssume: the assignment panel needs its own CLI extension
observableCriteria: does not build a fixed in-page panel

prompt: The dashboard shows chart skeletons for two seconds and then becomes blank. Find and fix the issue.
mustNotAssume: successful build means the feature works
observableCriteria: inspects browser console and failed requests
keeps a localized error state instead of blanking the page
